title: FinalMLP: An Enhanced Two-Stream MLP Model for CTR Prediction

layout.note: Three units in a row: a tall central stack (b) of six labelled layers read bottom to top, flanked by two tinted dashed zoom frames, (a) on the left and (c) on the right; the right frame holds two titled halves split by a dashed divider.

lesson: Draw the general framework once as a labelled layer stack, colour only the new modules warmly, and enlarge each into a tinted dashed frame tied back by thin leader lines, so the contribution is both located and opened up.
